extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: Now, what matters most to you — keeping your doctors, or the lowest premium?
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed all compliance rules, including delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment before scheduling the appointment. The customer was informed about plan options and the agent scheduled a plan review.
composition.coaching_note: Grace did well in following all the necessary steps for compliance. However, she could improve by providing a bit more detail about the plans during the initial discussion, such as mentioning the network coverage and any additional benefits.
